description: This file defines a RoleValidator class that implements Spring's Validator interface for validating Role objects in the OpenMRS medical record system. It checks for null, empty, whitespace, and trailing space constraints on the role attribute, and validates field lengths.

classes.name: RoleValidator
classes.description: A validator class for Role objects, ensuring roles meet certain validation criteria before being processed or persisted.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Determines if this validator supports validating instances of the specified class (Role).

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the Role object, checking for nulls, whitespaces, and field lengths.
